variables.name: Altitude
variables.description: Elevation of the meteorological station above mean sea level, an immutable geographic variable that exerts strong orographic effects on local temperature, precipitation, and solar radiation.

variables.name: Temperature
variables.description: Mean ambient air temperature recorded at the station, representing the thermodynamic state of the near-surface atmosphere and a key driver of evapotranspiration and precipitation phase.

variables.name: Precipitation
variables.description: Cumulative precipitation amount including rainfall and snowfall, reflecting the integrated effect of atmospheric moisture transport, orographic lifting, and frontal activity at the station location.

variables.name: Longitude
variables.description: East-west geographic coordinate of the meteorological station, an immutable spatial variable that captures the influence of maritime versus continental climate regimes across the region.

variables.name: Sunshine
variables.description: Total duration of direct solar irradiance exceeding the threshold intensity of 120 W/m², a measure of insolation influenced by cloud cover, latitude, and season.

variables.name: Latitude
variables.description: North-south geographic coordinate of the meteorological station, an immutable spatial variable that determines solar angle, day length, and the climatological temperature gradient across the region.
